headline.text: L1 S1 Tunnel 1 belt frayed into product — cereal bed cleared, *no belt fragments* found in packed product after secondary inspection.

summary: One active hold at L1 S3 for product packaged without tie sheets. Belt fraying at L1 S1 triggered cereal bed removal; no foreign material found downstream. L3 ML4 overnight cleaning uncovered a damaged scraper left behind depositor and a frayed TG-3 belt flagged for replacement.

holds.title: S3 product held — no tie sheets
holds.summary: Die Cut Tie Sheets exhausted mid-shift; QA placed all product packaged without tie sheets on hold pending Monday delivery.
holds.status: On hold pending tie sheet arrival Monday and rework.

food_safety.title: S1 Tunnel 1 belt fraying — cereal bed cleared
food_safety.summary: Belt frays observed at Tunnel 1 exit at 18:25; team stopped line, cleared cereal bed from tunnel, passed all Tunnel 2 and downstream product — no frays found in packed pouches.
food_safety.status: Resolved — cereal bed discarded, all downstream product inspected and released.

food_safety.title: ML4 damaged scraper left in WDS area
food_safety.summary: 3rd shift found a metal scraper component left behind depositor during teardown; flagged to 1st shift for removal and coaching.
food_safety.status: Resolved — item removed; shift coached on teardown protocol.

food_safety.title: ML4 TG-3 belt fraying observed
food_safety.summary: QA flagged frayed TG-3 curved belt during 2nd shift inspection; team replaced belt, ATP passed, and flagged second frayed belt for replacement at next cleaning.
food_safety.status: Resolved — first belt replaced; second belt flagged for Monday clean replacement.

quality.title: ML4 lot code error — 2 pallets reworked
quality.summary: Packing area changed to wrong lot code and date; 2 pallets flagged and being reworked to correct labeling.

quality.title: S4 soft caramel at startup
quality.summary: First tunnel batch came out soft; team removed ~1 cover worth, subsequent product met consistency spec.
quality.status: Resolved — startup product discarded, line stabilized.

quality.title: S1 checkweigher high reject rate
quality.summary: Checkweigher rejected many pouches overnight; maintenance verified scale accuracy, rejects confirmed as true over/underweight.
quality.status: Resolved — checkweigher accurate, upstream dosing variability addressed.

quality.title: ML4 blooming product at demold
quality.summary: Product bloomed after sitting in cooling cabinets overnight from 3rd shift downtime; team pulled bloomed bars, resumed with fresh product meeting spec.
quality.status: Resolved — bloomed product removed, line resumed within spec.

opportunities.text: Consider adding belt-edge inspection to Tunnel 1 startup checklist — today's fraying event and visual checks every 30 minutes caught buildup before it reached product.
Review ML4 cleaning teardown shadow board or checklist — the scraper left behind WDS and previous similar incidents suggest a tool-accountability gap.
Consider adding TG belt condition to ML4 pre-shift or cleaning inspection — two frayed belts flagged within 24 hours suggest wear pattern worth monitoring.
